## MCP - Tokenizer

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/tokenizer

**Description:** Estime le nombre de tokens pour un texte donne et calcule l'utilisation du contexte pour differents modeles LLM.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["user_id", "guild_id", "user_request", "text"],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID utilisateur (credits, quotas)" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID serveur Discord" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "Requete utilisateur originale" },
    "text": { "type": "string", "description": "Texte a tokenizer" },
    "model": { "type": "string", "description": "Modele pour limite de contexte (default: gpt-4o)" }
  }
}
```

**Modeles supportes:**
- OpenAI: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo
- Anthropic: claude-3-opus, claude-3-sonnet, claude-3-haiku, claude-3.5-sonnet
- Mistral: mistral-large, mistral-small
- Google: gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["estimated_tokens", "context_limit", "usage_percent", "statistics"],
  "domain": "utility"
}
```

**Note:** Les comptes de tokens sont des estimations (~5-10% variance).
